title: Measure the Orphaned accessibility check on the next pro-ui run
why: Batch PR 279 merged without the Orphaned accessibility check: run 42625642858 skipped the pro-ui jobs, so whether the discard-lapses element passes is not known.
note: The next run carrying the pro-ui label measures it. If the check flags the element, a lane either drops the label or value from the probe, or skips it by name under audit-skips-measured-flags. Source: lane armed-discard-clock, via the coordinator, 2026-11-09 08:19 CST.
